This site hosts static [Quarto dashboards](https://quarto.org/docs/dashboards/) for exploring Everglades National Park buoy data from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html).

## Dashboards

- [**Current vs Usual →**](context_dashboard.html) — compare today's readings to each buoy's past-year distribution and seasonal range
- [**Salinity & Temperature Maps →**](maps_dashboard.html) — paired salinity and temperature maps side by side, with hourly interpolated fields
- [**Salinity Dashboard →**](dashboard.html) — salinity overview, interpolated fields, and station gauges

The dashboards reuse interpolation and mapping methods from the [south-florida-salinity](https://github.com/usf-imars/south-florida-salinity) project:

- **Leaflet** htmlwidgets for interactive buoy maps ([Quarto htmlwidgets](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/widgets/htmlwidgets.html))
- **DIVAnd** variational analysis with bathymetry-aware land masking
- Hourly field panels at 06:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 24:00 US Eastern

## Build locally

```bash
quarto render
```

To publish as a static site on GitHub Pages:

```bash
make publish
```
